newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end weak,market in bear phase.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end weak,market in bear phase.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures gave up some of their early gains to end weaker on Friday ahead of a long weekend and dealers said the market appeared to have entered a bearish chart pattern.
After opening sharply higher following strong gains on Wall Street and a firm finish on Chicago Nikkei futures, the benchmark March contract finished 55 points lower at 19,595.
"We should see an upward correction to about 19,680 but then it'll go down all the way," said a chartist with a local house.
He said the March Nikkei could test support around 19,500 and head for the more crucial level of 19,400-19,485.
"If that's broken, it would be downhill all the way," he said, adding that the contract could then reach 18,500 over the next couple of months. "The overall position is still very bearish."
Another trader said the March Nikkei could fall to 18,600-18,700 if it penetrated and closed below the support area of 19,550-19,595.
"Any buy signal would just induce liquidating of short positions. The Nikkei still has ground to dig lower but the upside looks limited," he said.
